material_definitions: Lithium aluminum titanium phosphate glass-ceramics are synthesized with the general formula Li1+xAlxTi2-x(PO4)3.
The specific composition investigated in this figure is for x=0.45.
Samples are prepared as glass-ceramics, implying a melt-quenching and subsequent crystallization process.
The conductivity is separated into bulk and grain-boundary contributions using complex impedance spectroscopy.
measurements.source_caption: Temperature dependence of the bulk and grain-boundary conductivities of the glass-ceramics (x=0.45).
warnings: Values estimated from Arrhenius plot.

material_definitions: Aliovalent substitution in Li6+xP1-xGexS5I was performed to investigate changes to the argyrodite structure and Li+ transport.
Variations in lattice volume, Ge solubility, and I-/S2- site disorder were analyzed using diffraction and NMR techniques.
Increasing Ge content expands the lattice and opens bottlenecks, leading to a significant drop in the activation barrier.
Sintering the pellets of Li6.6P0.4Ge0.6S5I significantly enhances the ionic conductivity from 5.4 to 18.4 mS cm-1.
The resulting high-performance solid electrolytes enable the stable cycling of solid-state batteries with thick electrodes.
warnings: Temperature not explicitly mentioned in the provided text; assumed room temperature (25 Celsius).

material_definitions: This study investigates the effect of Ge4+ substitution in Li6+xP1-xGexS5I to overcome the low ionic conductivity of the parent Li6PS5I phase.
The material series is characterized by an increase in lattice volume and the induction of site disorder between S2- and I- ions upon aliovalent Ge4+ doping.
Structural analysis reveals that Ge substitution expands Li+ diffusion pathways and significantly reduces the activation barrier for ion migration.
The resulting electrolytes demonstrate exceptionally high lithium-ion conductivities, reaching values up to 18.4 mS/cm.
These fast-ionic conductors enable stable long-term cycling in all-solid-state batteries, even when using thick electrode configurations.
warnings: Temperature not explicitly stated in the text; 25°C (room temperature) assumed for comparison.
Value cited from Kraft et al.

material_definitions: The Li+ superionic argyrodites Li6+xP1-xGexS5I have been synthesized with increasing Ge4+/P5+ ratios to study structural changes and ionic conductivity.
Full solid solutions of Li6+xP1-xGexS5I can be synthesized up to a composition of at least Li6.7P0.3Ge0.7S5I.
Minor impurity phase fractions of LiI and/or Li4GeS4 were found in the diffraction data for the series of solid solutions.
Sintering of the cold pressed pellets at 823 K for ten minutes significantly increases the conductivity due to better grain contact.
measurements.source_caption: Activation barrier and ionic conductivity of Li6+xP1-xGexS5I as a function of the refined Ge content, as obtained from impedance spectroscopy.
warnings: Value corresponds to cold-pressed pellets.
